Status

Active
See also: Quests

Legend

A Father wishes to get his four sons gifts on their mutual birthday.

Location

Edron, Zao Wailing Widow Cave, Isle of the Kings, Barbarian Settlements, Dwarf Mines, Thais Dragon Lair, Banuta, Ankrahmun Tombs

Dangers

Zao lesser creatures, Wailing Widows, lesser Undead, Demon Skeletons, Barbarians, Dwarves, Dragons, Apes, Ankrahmun Tombs creatures.

Reward

28,000 exp, 8,000 gp, Old Cape

Requirements

  • Rope
  • Shovel
  • Pick
  • Travel money
  • Melee weapon or Firebug to break the Spiderwebs
  • Completed first mission of The New Frontier Quest
  • Completed first mission of The White Raven Monastery Quest

Mission

First of all, go to Edron and find the NPC Tereban. He is above the depot, at Mirabell's tavern (here (33168, 31811, 6)). Ask him for a mission and accept it with yes.

You are asked to find rare components of items. These items are found in dungeons. You can do these missions at any time, in any order, and you don't have to report a completed mission before doing another. You will receive 2500 experience for each item you turn in. When you hand in the last of the items, you can finally receive the Old Cape as well as 8,000 additional experience and gold.

The items and the city they are closest to are:

Quest Items and Closest Cities
Quest Item Closest city
Strong Sinew Edron
Exquisite Wood Svargrond
Spectral Cloth Carlin
Exquisite Silk Farmine
Magic Crystal Ankrahmun
Mystic Root Port Hope
Old Iron Kazordoon
Flexible Dragon Scale Thais

The Magic Bow - Sinew

Go to the Edron Wyvern Hill (here (33241, 31767, 7)) and fight your way to the far east. On the north side there is a sealed door. Go in and up the ramp, kill Heoni (who is about as strong as a Wyvern) and use the dead Heoni in order to obtain Strong Sinew. You do not have to kill Heoni yourself, just use the corpse.

Obtained
 

Bring it back to Tereban by saying strong sinew.

The Magic Bow - Wood

Go to Svargrond and head west out of town, continue west over the mountain, down the stairs and continue west to the raider camp or if you have completed the Barbarian Test travel with Buddel to the raider camps. Proceed north across the thin sheet of ice to Bittermor, the northern glacial camp. In this camp, directly north of the entrance, is a sealed door (here (31987, 31226, 7)). Go in it and open the box to receive the Exquisite Wood.

Obtained
 

Bring it back to Tereban by saying exquisite wood.

The Magic Robe - Cloth

Go to the Isle of the Kings and descend to the 6th floor of the catacombs. Go north-west until the end and use a Pick in the shadow of a Stone Pillar (here (32162, 31921, 13)). Go down the hole to the 7th floor and go west until you find the sealed door. Go in it and open the chest for the Spectral Cloth.

Obtained
 

Bring it back to Tereban by saying spectral cloth.

Use Pick behind the pillar.

The Magic Robe - Silk

Go to the Zao Wailing Widow Cave, the entrance to which can be found north-east of the central orc camp (here (33222, 31398, 7)). From the first floor ramp, go south-west and open the Spider Webs with your melee weapon or Firebug. Go through the web opening and down the ramp at the end of the passage. Now go south-west and follow the cave south, then south-east before it turns north-east. You will need to open another set of Spider Webs with your weapon or firebug before continuing north-east in search of a ramp along the southern wall of the cave. You are now at the final floor. Proceed west and go through the sealed door to a room with 4 Wailing Widows. Kill them and use the Spider Victim in the middle of the room to get the Exquisite Silk.

Obtained
 

Bring it back to Tereban by saying exquisite silk.

The Magic Rod - Crystal

Go to Ankrahmun and exit the city from the north-eastern ramp. Follow the city's walls south to the south-eastern part of Darama. Dig for the Shadow Tomb (here (33255, 32833, 7)), go in and down to the 5th floor. Go to the northern part of this floor (here (33235, 32808, 12)) and find a sealed door. Go in and use the sarcophagus at the northern side of the room to obtain the Magic Crystal.

Obtained
 

Bring it back to Tereban by saying magic crystal.

The Magic Rod - Root

Go to Port Hope and head to Banuta. If you have a high enough Paw and Fur Society rank you can travel directly to Banuta via Lorek's ferry. When you reach Banuta, go down the southern-most staircase (here (32826, 32576, 7)). You will face a lot of Apes here. Go north all the way (to here (32815, 32505, 8)) and through the sealed door. Open the box to obtain the Mystic Root.

Obtained
 

Bring it back to Tereban by saying mystic root.

Start
Door

The Magic Shield - Iron

Go to Kazordoon and find the Steamship. You can travel directly from Cormaya or Farmine, walk through the city's mine or take the Ore Wagons. When you reach the steamship, go up from the steamship twice to reach the main floor with Dwarves and Dwarf Soldiers. Go south-west and down the hole to a single Dwarf Guard. Kill the guard and open the sealed door to the west of the room. Open the box to find the Old Iron.

Obtained
 

Bring it back to Tereban by saying old iron.

The Magic Shield - Scale

Go to Thais and follow the dirt path north to Greenshore. When you cross the bridge to Greenshore, search for a hidden pitfall behind a tree a few steps north of the ramps (here (32300, 32097, 7)). Down there are Orcs and Orc Spearmen. Kill them and go down again, but be mindful of the traps on the floor which may damage you. Follow the cave south and kill the various Orcs before going down again. Go south a bit and then west all the way to reach the Greenshore Dragon Lair. Go up and kill the Dragon who is accompanied by a Dragon Hatchling. Find a thin corridor on the western part of the lair which leads to a sealed door. Go in and kill Glitterscale, who has about the same strength of a Dragon. When slain, use the Dead Glitterscale to obtain the Flexible Dragon Scale.

Obtained
 

Bring it back to Tereban by saying flexible dragon scale.

Transcripts

Accepting the Mission

Player: hi
Tereban: Greetings, friend.
Player: mission
Tereban: I have four sons which are very dear to me. Though they were born on the same day and even in the same hour, they took quite different paths in life. ...
Tereban: Each of them chose a different vocation, one will become a knight, one a sorcerer, one a druid, and the other a paladin. In a few weeks they will reach adulthood and I am holding a birthday party for them. ...
Tereban: It should become a day to remember and so I want to give them something special as a present. I searched the land for the finest craftsmen so they could create suitable presents for my sons. ...
Tereban: But something of fine craftsmanship will just not cut it. So I asked them what they would need to create something special. They all came up with lists of rare and expensive items necessary for the task ahead. ...
Tereban: I spent a small fortune to buy most of the materials but in the end the key components are that rare that they cannot be simply bought somewhere. ...
Tereban: As far as I understood it, the places where you can get these items are quite dangerous and so it would take some adventurer to get them. ...
Tereban: That would be your mission if you are interested. Uhm, so are you interested?
Player: yes
Tereban: I am relieved someone as capable as you will handle the task. Well, I need the parts of a sorcerer's robe, a paladin's bow, a knight's shield, and a druid's wand.
Player: bye
Tereban: Farewell.
